_comment: The structured Deal Intake Form the realtor fills in once. Groups map to UI sections. Each field lists which form(s)/field_id(s) it feeds — 'profile' means it's also in deal_profile_schema.json (shared across forms), 'form_specific' means it only appears on one form. Radio/checkbox 'options' give the value code to write for the fill pipeline (reverse-engineered from real filled PDFs, order = order of appearance in the form, not guaranteed Yes-first).

fields.label: Landlord's Address for Notices — Unit (optional)
fields.note: 2229E s.3 / Form 400 'Address of Landlord' — the legal address for receiving notices. Split into separate components because both forms lay them out as separate boxes on one line.

groups.label: Property
groups.note: Can be pre-filled from a pasted REALM listing export — realtor should still confirm each value, especially the known traps flagged below.

fields.note: property_city with any trailing TRREB district code stripped. 291/292 print AREA, MUNICIPALITY and COMMUNITY as separate columns, so the code belongs in mls_area, not in the municipality box.

fields.label: Is this unit in a condominium?
Property address (one line)
fields.note: Assembled from the address fields above by lib/profileMapper.ts.

fields.label: Monthly Rent (in words — auto-derivable from amount)
fields.note: Computed by withComputedValues from monthly_rent_amount. Was visible and extractable, which meant the model was asked to write an amount out in words and the realtor could type a third version.

options.label: Key deposit required (enter amount + details below)

fields.label: Key/fob/access card details (e.g. '2 keys, 2 mailbox keys, 2 fobs')
Deposit Amount for Agreement to Lease ($)
Premises to be used only for

groups.label: Utilities & Included Services
groups.note: TRAP (from real ground-truth comparison): a listing's 'Heating Source: Gas' does NOT mean gas is included in rent, and a unit having central A/C or ensuite laundry does NOT mean it's an included service — these must be answered from the actual deal terms, never copied 1:1 from listing features.

fields.label: Is air conditioning included in rent?
Commission Amount / Terms (e.g. 'Half Month Rent + HST')

groups.label: Confirmation of Co-operation & Representation (Form 324 only)
groups.note: These are independent checkboxes (not mutually exclusive radios) — realtor selects whichever representation scenarios actually apply.

fields.label: Landlord Brokerage represents Landlord only (single representation)
Landlord Brokerage is assisting a self-represented Tenant
Landlord Brokerage pays Co-operating Brokerage per MLS commission

groups.label: Rental Application Details (Form 410 only)
groups.note: This is real applicant-screening data — DOB, driver's license/SIN, employment, bank/reference details. Not derivable from any listing; always direct realtor/applicant entry. Full field list: forms/schemas/form_410_raw.json (121 fields total, applicant #1 and #2 symmetric).

fields.label: Seller - phone
fields.note: Form 101 page 5, the (Tel. No.) under the seller's Address for Service. Was labelled 'phone / email'; the box is a telephone number, and the address lines beside it have no intake answer yet.

fields.label: Buyer - Address
fields.note: 371 splits this into txtb_streetnum and txtb_street; the intake asks for one line, so it goes in the street box and the number box stays blank.

fields.label: Purchase price (in words)
fields.note: Computed from the purchase price by lib/profileMapper.ts.

fields.label: Deposit (in words)
fields.note: Computed from the deposit amount by lib/profileMapper.ts.

fields.label: Deposit submitted
fields.note: hidhereupon, the blank after 'DEPOSIT: Buyer submits'. Prints on page 1, verified by render.

fields.label: Offer irrevocable by (Seller/Buyer)
fields.note: hidirrev_v_p. The hid prefix is WEBForms naming, not a hidden field - it prints on page 1, verified by render.

fields.label: Municipality
fields.note: The blank after 'in the' on page 1. WEBForms splits that one blank into two boxes, hidInThe then txtInThe2; the municipality goes in the first. Verified by filling both with distinguishable text and reading the render - it was the only line on page 1 still printing empty.
The box is 211pt wide, the same class as txtCommencingDate_m which takes the month name, so this is the word and not a number.
Computed by withComputedValues from listing_price, like purchase_price_words.

291/292 print the date as MM / DD / YYYY in three labelled boxes. The _day/_month/_year trio is shaped for OREA's 'the ___ day of ___, 20___' and would print 'September' and '26' into boxes captioned MM and YYYY.

groups.label: MLS(R) Data Information Form
groups.note: Page 1 of PropTx Forms 291/292 - the board's own data form. Almost all of it is on the listing the realtor already uploads, so these are extraction targets first and questions second.

fields.label: MLS(R) number(s)
fields.note: Moved here from the seller_direction group so the lease-landlord set can reach it too; Form 244 still uses it.

fields.label: Community
fields.note: Marked mandatory-if-available on the form itself.

fields.label: Street type abbreviation (St, Ave, Rd)
fields.note: 292 only. 291 carries the street type in hidp_uploadstreettype, a hidden upload field with no printed box.

fields.label: Directions
fields.note: 291 names this box txtcrossstrts, which is NOT the cross-streets box - confirmed by rendering the page with each field showing its own id. Its cross-streets box is txtmaincs.

fields.label: Lease or sub-lease?
fields.note: Option codes read off the widget rects and matched to the printed captions, not guessed.

fields.label: Possession date
fields.note: The form requires either this or possession remarks.
PropTx prints the possession date as MM / DD / YYYY, so it uses the numeric date parts computed in lib/profileMapper.ts, not the OREA trio.

fields.label: No conveyance of offers prior to (time)
No conveyance of offers prior to (date)
Schedule letter (A, B, …)
fields.note: The blank in the 'Schedule ____' heading. A schedule exists to be attached to and identified by another agreement, so generating one with a nameless heading left the realtor writing it in by hand every time.

groups.label: RECO Information Guide
groups.note: RECO requires you to walk every client through this guide before providing services, and to have them acknowledge it. These answers fill the acknowledgement page; the signatures are left for you and the client to sign.

fields.label: Your name (the agent providing the guide)
Your brokerage name
fields.note: Your own brokerage, not the other side's — the guide is an acknowledgement that YOU walked the client through it, so this is the same on every form set regardless of which side you represent. Seeded from Settings in app/api/deals/route.ts.

fields.label: Date the guide was provided (written out)
Client name (the buyer, seller, tenant or landlord you represent)
fields.note: Deliberately its own question rather than reused from the parties section: who your client is depends on which side of the deal you are on, and the existing tenant/landlord/buyer/seller fields can't express that per set.
